channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Moscow and Kyiv trade accusations of violating ceasefire
item.description: Moscow and Kyiv accuse each other of violating ceasefire. Ukraine war briefing: Moscow and Kyiv trade accusations of violating ceasefire The Guardian.

item.title: Dozens killed in fresh attacks in central Mali: local, security sources
item.description: Al-Qaeda-linked JNIM killed dozens in central Mali attacks. Attacks on May 8 were claimed by the Al-Qaeda-linked Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM), who had already killed at least 30 people in attacks on villages on May 6.

item.title: U.S. awaits Iran's response on peace deal as month-long ceasefire holds
item.description: US awaits Iran's response on peace deal amid month-long ceasefire. Live Updates: U. S. awaits Iran's response on peace deal as month-long ceasefire holds CBS News. U. S.

item.title: Lasting Truce Is Elusive After Week of Traded Attacks
item.description: Russian and Ukrainian forces continued to exchange attacks, making a lasting truce elusive. The violence has persisted despite international efforts to broker a ceasefire. The situation remains volatile in the region.

item.title: Putin says he thinks Ukraine conflict 'coming to an end'
item.description: Putin says Ukraine conflict is coming to an end. The Russian leader sees potential for Ukraine negotiations, but condemns the West's backing for President Zelensky. Putin says he thinks Ukraine conflict 'coming to an end'.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine war 'coming to an end,' Putin says amid ceasefire, scaled-back parade
item.description: Putin claims Russia-Ukraine war is ending amid ceasefire. Russia-Ukraine war 'coming to an end,' Putin says amid ceasefire, scaled-back parade USA Today.

item.title: IRGC warns US against attacks on ships; Israel bombs Lebanon
item.description: Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps warned the US against attacks on ships, while Israel bombed Lebanon, killing 24 people. The US-Iran ceasefire remains in place despite the warning. US-Iran ceasefire holds as Tehran warns Washington against attacks on tankers and Israel kills 24 people in Lebanon.

item.title: Greek minister says mystery drone from a 'foreign state'
item.description: A mystery drone found off the Greek island of Lefkada may have originated from Ukraine, which has used drones to target Russian oil tankers in the Mediterranean. The Greek government is investigating the drone's origin.

item.title: China is no longer just protesting US sanctions - firms may now have to navigate two systems
item.description: China has invoked its "Blocking Rules" to counter US sanctions, forcing companies to navigate conflicting legal systems. This marks a shift from rhetoric to enforcement, leaving companies caught in the middle.

item.title: A tech writer puts Google’s AI to the test as a trip planner
item.description: Google's Gemini AI trip planner failed to include underwear on a packing list, highlighting its limitations. The AI tool is a digital Swiss Army knife for planning flights, activities, and routes, but it's not perfect.

item.title: Brazil judge bars law that could reduce Bolsonaro’s 27-year prison sentence
item.description: A Brazilian Supreme Court justice suspended a law that could have reduced President Bolsonaro's 27-year prison sentence. The law's use is pending further review by the court. Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes suspends use of law to reduce prison sentences, pending further review.

item.title: Putin says he thinks the war with Ukraine 'is coming to an end' as Trump-brokered 3-day ceasefire
item.description: Russian President Putin said he believes the war with Ukraine is coming to an end. A three-day ceasefire brokered by former US President Trump has begun. The ceasefire aims to reduce violence in the region.

item.title: Lebanon says Israeli strikes killed 39
item.description: Israeli strikes killed 39 people in Lebanon, despite a ceasefire deal announced last month. Israel and Hezbollah have continued to trade fire despite a ceasefire deal being announced last month.

item.title: One killed in Gaza as Turkish FM talks peace efforts with Hamas official
item.description: A person was killed in Gaza amid Turkish Foreign Minister's peace talks with a Hamas official. Israel's continued actions in the Strip have resulted in hundreds of deaths since a ceasefire agreement in October.

item.title: Three police officers killed in car bomb attack in northwest Pakistan
item.description: A car bomb attack in Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, killed three police officers. Bomber and several fighters detonate explosives-laden vehicle near security post in Bannu, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Three police officers killed in car bomb attack in northwest Pakistan.

item.title: Putin says Ukraine war winding down, blasts West for backing Kyiv
item.description: Russian President Putin stated the Ukraine war is winding down, criticizing the West for supporting Ukraine. He also expressed a willingness to meet Ukrainian President Zelenskyy, but only after conditions for a potential peace agreement are met.

item.title: Should we be worried about the hantavirus outbreak?
item.description: A hantavirus outbreak has raised concerns, drawing comparisons to the COVID-19 pandemic. The situation is being monitored, but specific details on the outbreak's severity and response are limited. The incident has drawn comparisons to the COVID-19 pandemic.

item.title: Iran reviewing U.S. proposal at ‘own pace’ as Trump awaits response, says report
item.description: Iran reviews a US proposal at its own pace, with no immediate response expected. The report said expectations had grown that Tehran would issue a response after U. S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio indicated that Washington was expecting an answer from Iran.

item.title: Putin says Ukraine war likely to end soon - despite Ukrainian battlefield gains
item.description: President Vladimir Putin said the Ukraine war is likely to end soon, despite Ukrainian battlefield gains. President Vladimir Putin has said he believes the Ukraine war is coming to an end.

item.title: Putin says he thinks Ukraine war is 'coming to an end'
item.description: Putin said the Ukraine war is coming to an end as a three-day ceasefire began. Moscow and Kyiv are observing the truce. The Russian president made the remarks as Moscow and Kyiv observe a three-day ceasefire in their four-year conflict.
